canonical_project: Cosmas Data City - Cape Town (Cavaleros Group 360MW campus)
owner: Cavaleros Group / Cosmas Data Cities (CDC), with Knight Frank & Future-tech

location.subnational: Western Cape - City of Cape Town

notes: Cavaleros Group launched data-centre division Cosmas Data Cities (Nov 2025, DCD): 100-acre/100-hectare Cape Town campus could total 360MW (360MVA available power per Baxtel) to become one of the largest DC availability zones in Sub-Saharan Africa; sister campus at Samrand (Johannesburg, 200MW via 450MW self-built switching station) is in Tshwane division. Status announced/planned; no zoning/EA/building records found yet - early-stage lead per methodology (announced = C/B-).
